verification.method: scripts/verify/india.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100 (all table years), rank, share, growth, change, density, land area
Year India passed China (2022) and the gap in 2026 and 2050
Peak (2061, 1.70 billion), first fall (2062), 2100 total and the year India reaches that size
Fertility 1960 and 2026, first year below 2.1 (2020); births peak (2001), births 2026 and per day
Infant mortality 1950, 2000, 2026; life expectancy 1950, 2019, 2021, 2026; median age 2026, 2050, 2100
Title, meta description, Article headline, FAQ answers in JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 82 of 82 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file

Indian Economic Service (Government of India), Arthapedia "Urban": Census of India definition (statutory towns; census towns with 5,000+ people, 400+ per km², 75%+ of male main workers non-agricultural)
